say:2:1610506501:1.text: "Self-Portrait of Pellin"? Anyone know who Pellin is?

say:4:1610506502:1.text: Pellin was a renowned mage and guest professor here at the Lyceum about two centuries ago. Painting was just one of his hobbies; he also enjoyed sculpture and the art of jewelry crafting.
say:4:1610506502:1.source_cn: 他是近两个世纪前的人了，一位著名魔法师，曾担任莱希拉姆...

say:5:1610506503:1.text: Oh! My mother owns a necklace signed "Pellin". She loves it, and it has 120 amethysts... So luxurious and elegant!
say:5:1610506503:1.source_cn: 啊，对了！母亲有一条很喜欢的项链，制作者签名就是佩莱。...
